# Holi Labs

Holi Labs publishes practical tutorials, field notes, experiments, and reviewed
technical papers for the Holi.tools ecosystem in English, Spanish, Chinese,
Hindi, Arabic, Bengali, and Portuguese.

## URL

- https://labs.holi.tools/
- Papers collection: https://labs.holi.tools/en/papers/

## Purpose

- Teach local-first file, QR, Typst, privacy, performance, and graphics patterns.
- Separate measured or verified behavior from hypotheses and experiments.
- Treat Papers as a long-form editorial format inside Labs, never as a separate
  Holi product or deployment.
- Keep technical writing close to shipped code and testable behavior.

## Implementation Parameters

- App package: `holi-labs`
- App path: `web/apps/labs`
- Content source: `web/apps/labs/src/content`
- Product context: `docs/product.md`
- Project map: `docs/architecture.md`
- Current priorities: `docs/roadmap.md`

## Bot Guidance

- Treat Labs as educational and explanatory content, not normative behavior.
- For product requirements, prefer `spec/` and accepted decision records.
- For implementation details, inspect the referenced app or crate.
